study: Heller et al. 2012 (JRST) — same RCT as Heller 2010 (journal version); 3 science-PD arms vs control, electric circuits, grade 4
delivery_evidence: Each intervention was '24 hours of contact time, divided into eight 3-hour sessions,' delivered face-to-face by course facilitators (Methods, p.~340-342).
test_alignment_evidence: Outcome is a 34-item developer-made selected-response electric-circuits content test (alpha 0.87), proximal to the PD content; extraction labels test_type=researcher_made (Table 4 p.351).
curriculum_evidence: PD develops teachers' science content/PCK for the electric-circuits unit within the standards-based student curricula they were already responsible for ('their own students', 'their own classrooms'); no new curriculum adopted (Methods, p.~340-343).
outcome_timing_evidence: Extracted wave is the study-year (immediate post) pretest-to-posttest gain within 2 weeks of completing the unit (2007-08); the follow-up-year cohort was not extracted (Table 4 p.351; Question 3 p.352).
